items.text: Commandos,
We have just released Update 1.7 for Commandos: Origins for all available platforms.
This update improves performance (notably related to viewcones via a new Graphics API option), and fixes multiple gameplay and AI issues, it also resolves various localization and UI bugs.
For more details, please check out the full changelog below.
Added a new "Graphics API" option in Video Settings.
Players experiencing performance drops when activating viewcones (especially on AMD GPUs) can now switch to DirectX 12 to improve framerate.
Fixed an issue where knocked-out AI units would remain prone after loading a save.
Fixed an issue where enemies failed to detect the player inside a full viewcone near the rifle clue in Operation Vulpes.
Fixed an issue where the radio signal was not visually restored after loading.
Fixed an issue where cutscene dialogue and audio did not trigger if a global alarm had already been activated.
Fixed an issue where AI lights did not function correctly in Operation Vulpes.
Fixed an issue where the knife kill stat was counted twice on the mission overview screen.
Fixed an issue where disguise highlighting would reset after loading.
Fixed camera glitches in Command Mode.
\[“No Man Left Behind” DLC] Fixed a tree culling issue after loading saves.
Fixed an issue where players could not navigate to the "Open Shop" button in the DLC ad window using a gamepad.
Fixed an issue where Sniper dialogue cut off and overlapped during the objective (Locate Agent Wake) in Operation Vulpes.
Corrected typos and grammatical errors in the "Undercover Agents" collectible during Operation Rooster.
Corrected an error in the Polish translation where "water tank" was incorrectly translated as "war tank".
\[“No Man Left Behind” DLC] Fixed inconsistent naming of Sapper and Sniper in the Japanese localization.
Commandos,
We have just released Update 1.6 for Commandos: Origins for all available platforms.
This update introduces a new Story Mode difficulty, improves overall balance, and delivers a wide range of fixes across AI, multiplayer, and core gameplay systems.
For more details, please check out the full changelog below.
We’ve added a new Story Mode difficulty to let players experience the campaign and DLC missions without getting stuck on challenging encounters.
More ammunition and ability charges
Designed for a smoother, story-focused experience
Also allows experimenting with equipment normally gated behind pickups
Bonus Achievement
A Soldier’s Best Tool Since 1939
Eliminate 3 enemies at once using an explosive barrel
Enemies
Enemy health now varies based on unit type and difficulty
Normal soldiers and workers are more vulnerable on higher difficulties
High-ranking officers are tougher on lower difficulties
Added a short delay before enemies raise the alarm after spotting a commando
Vehicles
Reduced damage when vehicles collide with obstacles at low speed
Explosive trucks are now more durable
Explosive truck canisters now behave like standard explosive barrels
SMGs and pistols deal more damage to vehicles
Weapons & Abilities
Increased range of the M1911 pistol
Luger pistol: reduced ammo on higher difficulties, but can eliminate enemies in one shot
AT grenade: increased damage to vehicles and larger effective range
Landmines: larger trigger radius and reduced noise
Ammo and ability charges rebalanced across all difficulties
Command Mode
Fixed issues where commands were not executed correctly
Fixed Sniper Double Kill failures when using Command Mode
Improved reliability of movement to execution positions
Multiplayer & Co-op
Fixed an issue where enemies could stand up incorrectly
Fixed multiple pointer placement issues
Improved pointer accuracy on moving targets
AI & Enemy Behavior
Fixed inconsistencies in enemy behavior before and after loading
Fixed AI routines not executing correctly in certain situations
General Fixes & Improvements
AI lights now properly reveal the player
Sound Decoy can now be used from climbable positions
Players are no longer detected while on climbables
Fixed several AI sliding / stuttering issues
Fixed vehicle kills not counting toward stats
Improved minimap responsiveness
Minor UI and stat screen improvements
UI & Misc
DLC window now features a “Shop” button
Added tutorial clarification in the Harbour mission (Marine objective)
Commandos,
We have just released an update that fixes some achievement-related issues and a crash.
The changelog can be found below.
Fixes

\[Shadows over Crete] Fixed an issue where some DLC achievements (“Ripe for Picking”, “Ghost of Crete”, “Island vacation”, "Quite the Catch" and “Crete Veterans”) did not always unlock correctly on certain platforms including Steam and Xbox.

Fixed an issue where beating mission 1 of the base game (Operation Daybreak) did not always count for achievement progress until all 14 base game missions were finished and any mission was finished a second time. This affected multiple achievements, including “Knock Them Out With Kindness” and “Shadow Tactics”.
Fixed a rare crash related to the view cone settings.
Commandos!
We've just released Update 1.5 for all available platforms, which includes a fix for invisible doors in specific missions, among various other fixes for mission-specific issues.
Furthermore, Update 1.5 for Commandos: Origins includes various other fixes and adds 3 new achievements.
Additionally, Commandos: Origins Shadows over Crete is now available!
For more details, please check out the full changelog below.
Consider it done

Operation Reckoning (14) – Fixed an issue where double clicking the “Find Broch’s secret documents” objective would still make the camera pan to locations where the document was already picked up.

4) UI/Settings Fixes
Fixed an issue where the kill count on the post mission overview screen would sometimes not include the Marine’s harpoon and throwing knife kills.
Fixed an issue where the description for “Active Character Highlight” would show the description text for “Disable Blood Effects”.
\ Fixed an issue where buttons on the post mission overview screen were not accessible via keyboard, only with a mouse.
5) Other Fixes
Fixed an issue where the view cone marker was not always reacting to enemy view cones when an object was in between the enemy and the marker without completely blocking the view cone.
Fixed an edge case issue where following Commandos would get stuck when group selecting Commandos and ordering them to climb a pole.
Fixed an issue where Patrol group soldiers would be slow in grouping up again if the group got disrupted.
Fixed an issue where Enemy drivers would sometimes not correctly enter their vehicles and start to drive.
Fixed an issue where telling a Commando to lie down and pick up an enemy body in quick succession while already carrying a body would lead to him performing a small jump.
Fixed an issue where a sniper shot in Command Mode would not correctly penetrate multiple enemies after saving and loading in between planning and executing the action.
Fixed an issue where a Commando would not always follow enemies correctly if an action was planned in command mode and the enemy moved out of range.
\[RTS Control Scheme] Fixed an issue where placing or picking up an item on top of another Commando would select this Commando.
6) Platform/Input Specific Fixes
\[PS5, PS4, Epic] Fixed an issue where the Achievements “Knock Them Out With Kindness” and “No Stone Left Unkilled” were being awarded without meeting all requirements.
\ Fixed an issue where the player was unable to change stance with gamepad in Command Mode.
7) Localization Fixes
\[All languages] Fixed an issue where “Objective Marker” and “Mission Quick Start” were not being translated in the settings.
\ Fixed an issue where Western Arabic numbers or a missing icon were displayed instead of Eastern Arabic numbers.
\ Fixed an issue where some settings were not translated into Russian.
Commandos!

We've just released Update 1.4 for all available platforms, which includes several improvements like performance optimization, additional stat tracking UI elements and the option to disable the white circle around the active Commando.

Furthermore, Update 1.4 for Commandos: Origins includes many mission-specific fixes and further general bug fixes like VSync no longer causing screen tearing and motion blur settings now being applied correctly applied.

Additionally we have fixed an issue where the achievement trackers for "No Stone Left Unkilled" and "Knock Them Out With Kindness" were not tracking correctly and were not being unlocked within the in-game mission display.
Additionally, Commandos: Origins is now available on Xbox One and PlayStation®4.
For more details, please check out the full changelog below.
Consider it done

We just released Update 1.1 on all available platforms which includes various fixes for reported game and performance issues and crashes as well as some implemented feedback like a decreased size of the displayed version number.
For more details, please check out the full changelog below.
Fixed an issue where Pine trees had a significant performance impact. Maps with many pine trees like Operation Blindfold will now have improved performance.
Fixed: Big FPS drop in the mission accomplished cutscene of Operation Cleaver.
Fixed: A crash related to the frequent use of the Marine’s abilities.
Fixed: Rare Crash related to using command mode with multiple Commandos.
Fixed: Several other rare crashes.

Fixed: Achievement “Knock them out with kindness” not unlocking because of the mandatory kill of the enemy sniper in Operation Nightfall. This kill does not count for the achievement anymore.
Fixed: Achievement “Shadow Tactics” not unlocking after completing Operation Reckoning without raising an alarm.

We just released a hotfix on Steam with fixes for a misaligned cursor and several crashes.
Fixed a misaligned cursor issue related to the chosen game border settings.
Fixed a crash in multiplayer related to saving + loading while in range of an active sound decoy.
Fixed several other rare crashes.
We just released a hotfix on Steam that fixes an issue where sound was missing for some players. Other platforms will follow as soon as possible.

Removed "Audio Output Device" in-game option, to avoid conflicts with the preferred audio output device selected in the Windows settings. This conflict led to some players sometimes losing audio upon entering a mission or loading a savegame. The game will now refer to the Windows settings for choosing the audio output device.
Commandos!
We have just released a small update for the Commandos: Origins demo, that addresses some feedback and bug reports.

We have fixed an issue where key bindings were reset after loading a save game. Additionally, we've made several improvements, including simplifying the barrel-shooting mechanic, which no longer requires holding Ctrl.
You can find the full list of changes below.
Adjusted explosive barrel shooting mechanic and tutorial hint.: Like enemies, barrels can now be shot with a simple click, holding down the key is no longer required.
Adjusted picking up of sound decoy and tutorial hint.: Picking up sound decoy now works like picking up any other item by holding down the key and clicking .
Added chain pick up tutorial hint.: Added a new tutorial hint explaining that you can hold down key while ordering a melee attack to have the Commando pick up the body automatically.
Added quicksave/quickload button tutorial hint.: Added tutorial hint that explains that you can quicksave with F5 and quickload with F8.
Fixed a bug that reset hit points to 3 after loading with 1 hit point left.
Fixed custom key bindings resetting after loading.
Fixed a crash related to clicking “Default” and “Reset” buttons in the menu.
Removed demo unrelated files from the folder structure.
